datasets.title: Ls per sol: Mars24 algorithm (Allison and McEwen 2000), computed from the REMS MODRDR TIMESTAMP; CAB REMS daily weather JSON (Weather/weather.txt) kept only as a cross-check
datasets.used_for: Ls per sol in scripts/21_parse_rems.py via scripts/ls_mars24.py (season bins in rems_A.json, rems_B.json). weather.txt is no longer read by any script (Plan/20 P2-9).
datasets.credit: Mars24 algorithm, NASA GISS (M. Allison); cross-check file: Centro de Astrobiologia (CAB, CSIC-INTA), data from MSL/REMS
datasets.licence_or_terms: File text (disclaimer_en): 'The information contained into this file is provided by Centro de Astrobiologia (CAB) and is intended for outreach purposes only. Any other use is discouraged. CAB will take no responsibility for any result or publication made base on the content of this file. To access REMS scientific data, visit PDS at http://pds.nasa.gov.'
datasets.citation: Allison, M., and M. McEwen (2000), A post-Pathfinder evaluation of areocentric solar coordinates with improved timing recipes for Mars seasonal/diurnal climate studies, Planet. Space Sci., 48, 215-235, doi:10.1016/S0032-0633(99)00092-6. Allison, M. (1997), Accurate analytic representations of solar time and seasons on Mars with applications to the Pathfinder/Surveyor missions, Geophys. Res. Lett., 24, 1967-1970.
datasets.notes: Ls is evaluated at LMST 12:00 of each sol from the MODRDR TIMESTAMP (seconds since J2000). scripts/ls_mars24.py reproduces the Mars24 worked examples A and B (277.18758, 327.32416) and the published MSL landing value Ls 150.7 at 2012-08-06 05:18 UTC (Washington Univ. Analyst's Notebook MSL mission page; HiRISE ESP_028256_9022). Cross-check against weather.txt for the 1,009 route sols it lists: CAB = floor(Ls at the start of the sol) for 993 of them (all 325 route A sols); noon values are 0.22-1.31 deg higher. Earlier CAB notes: The download URL was not logged and the file's own text does not give one. The CAB REMS site is https://cab.inta-csic.es/rems/ . A guessed widget URL returned 404, so no endpoint is claimed. File dated 2026-11-14 on disk; 4745 sol records, sol 1 to 4995 (last terrestrial_date 2026-08-25). Replacement recommended: see sources/ls_recommendation.md. Project owner confirmed (2026-11-15) it came from the CAB REMS weather site; download date not recorded. Planned replacement: compute Ls from MODRDR TIMESTAMP (sources/ls_recommendation.md).
